prompt: Shoppers can now buy more than one of the same item. Add a way to compute the line price for `quantity` units of an item priced at `unitPriceCents`, expose it from src/checkout.js next to subtotal, and add a test for it.
expected_output: checkout.js gains a lineTotal(unitPriceCents, quantity) function. Since quantity is a plain count, not a second money amount, it multiplies unitPriceCents by quantity directly rather than calling a multiply method the money module does not export -- money.js only ever had add. A new test file covers the new function, and node --test still passes.

expectations.text: Nothing calls a multiply method the money module never exported
A new test file covers the added function
